description: This bar chart illustrates the ratio values for three large language models – Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT – across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled “Movies”, “Songs”, and “Basketball” in that order, while the vertical axis represents the ratio, labeled “Ratio (%)”, with a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals.  For each category, there are three bars representing the ratio for each model; Llama3 is represented by blue bars, Qwen2 by red bars, and ChatGPT by yellow bars. In the “Movies” category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 89%, the Qwen2 bar reaches approximately 87%, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 74%. For “Songs”, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 84%, the Qwen2 bar reaches approximately 88%, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 64%.  Finally, in the “Basketball” category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 68%, the Qwen2 bar reaches approximately 58%, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 62%. The bars are arranged in groups corresponding to each category, and are not sorted by value within each group. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
